subject: integration
name: Swarm standard (SWARM_0_1)
summary: A definition of SWARM_0_1: one read group (risk 2) and one function, get, that gives the bytes of a Swarm reference and an optional path, up to 4 MiB; a larger file is refused. Whoever answers learns which content is asked for, and peers can see it fetched. The definition says every chunk is checked against the reference; it cannot make a node do so, and its only test vector is a malformed reference. The row names no node or address. Level 4 with privacy: it runs and connects to nothing. Judged here by its publisher.
